{{Youmay|the chemical compounds named smelling salts|the similar [[stinksalts]]}}
'''Smelling salts''' were chemical compounds used to arouse consciousness.

==History==
During his service time in [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] circa [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Davin Felth/Legends|Davin Felth]] used smelling salts to help awaken a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who had fallen unconscious after becoming the biological attractant of several excited, full-grown [[Ronto/Legends|rontos]].<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
